claim_policy: Counts are estimates unless marked measured. No 50% reduction claim is made.

workflows.pain_point: Teacher needs the next class action immediately.
workflows.proposed_low_click_path: Teacher Workspace next-action strip opens attendance for the active class.
workflows.empty_state_behavior: Show no scheduled class with link to class planner.

workflows.pain_point: Marks entry should be reachable from pending work.
workflows.proposed_low_click_path: Pending work card links directly to marks grid.
workflows.empty_state_behavior: Show no pending marks and next assessment action.

workflows.pain_point: Report generation can split between analytics and report surfaces.
workflows.proposed_low_click_path: Governed report builder exposes one primary generate/export action.

workflows.pain_point: Payment must stay honest when PSP is external.
workflows.proposed_low_click_path: Money Center shows invoice, manual fallback, and receipt capture together.
workflows.empty_state_behavior: Show no invoice due with family summary.

workflows.pain_point: Manager route must not dead-end; tenant queues must remain isolated.
workflows.proposed_low_click_path: Manager route explains tenant scope and sends operator to school selector.
workflows.empty_state_behavior: Explain tenant-scoped sync when no tenant selected.

workflows.pain_point: Go-live blockers need one ordered queue.
workflows.proposed_low_click_path: Implementation Command Center exposes go-live score and primary next action.
workflows.empty_state_behavior: Show ready-to-launch confirmation and support playbook link.
